title: Remove Driftpod.fm GitHub repo link from APPS.md
author: alexander
pr_body_excerpt:
This PR removes the GitHub repository URL from the Driftpod.fm entry in apps/APPS.md.

**Reason**

The Driftpod.fm row currently contains a link to a GitHub repo (https://github.com/alexander/driftpod-pollinations). The repo is no longer live. This change removes that repository URL from the table entry so the cell is empty.

**Change**

apps/APPS.md: removed the GitHub repository URL from the Driftpod.fm table row. No code or functional changes — content-only documentation update.

gist.headline: One less dead branch
gist.blurb: The Driftpod.fm garden marker has been tidied up. Its retired GitHub trail is no longer pointing curious bees at an empty patch.
gist.summary: Removed the no-longer-live GitHub repository URL from the Driftpod.fm app listing metadata.
gist.impact: People browsing the Driftpod.fm entry will get a cleaner directory listing without a stale repository link.
